# snxpsamd.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

SUNIX Serial Driver x64 version 10.1.0.0 is affected by CVE-2024-55412. This exact signed build exposes raw I/O-port operations to low-privilege callers through IOCTLs including 0x9C403C04 and 0x9C403C08. An attacker can use the unrestricted port read/write primitives to disclose information, tamper with privileged hardware state, and elevate privileges.
- **UUID**: 300cdb55-6e01-4365-83e5-5783be2f9262
- **Created**: 2026-08-31
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: fluffycats31 | [@fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@fluffycats31)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create snxpsamd type= kernel binPath= C:\\windows\\temp\\snxpsamd.sys &amp;&amp; sc.exe start snxpsamd
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Read and write arbitrary I/O ports | User | Windows |
